sources.title: House Bill 843 (2026) — bill status page
sources.authorityNotes: Official legislative record. States: 'Amends existing law to eliminate proration of the homestead property tax exemption'; signed by the Governor March 31, 2026; Session Law Chapter 236; 'Effective: Retroactive to 01/01/2026'. Those strings are HTML-entity-encoded ( ) in the cache, so they are cited, not quoted; the quotable effective-date language is in the printed bill (idleg-2026-h0843-text). The 2026 legislation index (fetched to scratch, not cached) lists the chapter-236 row as 'Homestead exemption, proration | 03/31/26 | Retroactive to 01/01/2026'.
sources.stalenessRisk: NONE — historical record of an enacted bill.

sources.title: House Bill 843 (2026) — printed bill text (PDF)
sources.authorityNotes: Printed bill as introduced, cached as PDF and extracted with scripts/research/extract-pdf-text.mjs to data/idaho/raw/extracted/dea662824b1ba20c.txt. SECTION 2 is the emergency and retroactivity clause. pdftotext does not show strike-through/underline, so deleted and inserted statute text run together: never quote 63-602G from this file.
